info.name: EMPREINTE Live
info.summary: EMPREINTE Live brings video meetings into Nextcloud: start them from a Talk conversation, a document, or the calendar.
info.description:
EMPREINTE Live brings video meetings into Nextcloud: start them from a Talk conversation, a document, or the calendar. Free account creation is built into the app. Standalone app, it works alongside the official Talk, Calendar and Files apps without modifying them.
## 💬 Meetings from Talk
- 🤖 **Talk bot**: type `/empreinte <title> [tomorrow|DD/MM] [14:30] [45min]` in any conversation to create a meeting and post its link. The conversation's members are invited in one click. Set up automatically, enabled per conversation by its moderators. - 🪪 **Meeting cards**: a pasted meeting link shows its title, time and status with a "Join" button, in Talk, Text, Deck, Collectives and file comments (details visible to the creator only). - ➕ **Insert a meeting from the message box**: pick "EMPREINTE Live" in the link picker to list upcoming meetings or create one, and insert its participant link. - 🗨️ **Talk conversation for a meeting**, created from the meeting list, or the meeting link posted in an existing conversation.
## 📽️ Meetings from your files
- Present a document straight from Files: the "Present in a meeting" action on a PDF, PPTX or DOCX creates the meeting with the document already loaded in it, ready to present. - Participants suggested from the document's shares, completed by searching Nextcloud users and contacts, or by typing any email address. - Documents panel beside the meeting: browse the associated folder with previews, send more documents during the meeting, remove them. - Share links for one file or a whole folder (read-only or editable, password, expiration), including for participants without a Nextcloud account.
## 📅 Meetings from the calendar
- Integration with the official Nextcloud Calendar application. - Automatic synchronization when the linked calendar event is moved to trash, permanently deleted, or edited. - Reconciliation of the "EMPREINTE Live" calendar on login: back-fills missing meetings, hides meetings that belong to another account, never deletes anything on the EMPREINTE side.
## 🎥 Everything in one place
- Create, list, join and delete video meetings from the dedicated EMPREINTE Live app (its icon in the Nextcloud top app menu). - Organizer-only meeting link, reserved for the creator. - Unified search: find your meetings by title from the Nextcloud search.
## 🔐 Security
- Nextcloud permissions apply everywhere: a user with read-only access can neither present nor share, enforced by the server. - Secure connection to your EMPREINTE Live account using OAuth 2.0, with an explicit consent screen. - Server-side token management (no sensitive tokens exposed to the browser); public OAuth client secured by PKCE, no client secret to manage. - Native Nextcloud integration using official OCP APIs and events. Talk is optional, and nothing else changes without it.
## 🚀 Get started
Install the app, open **EMPREINTE Live** from the top menu and create your free account.
Need more than 5 participants or 2-hour sessions? EMPREINTE Live Pro adds longer sessions (12 h), more participants, live subtitles (FR/EN), document and spreadsheet sharing, and live streaming. → [empreinte.live](https://empreinte.live/?src=nextcloud)
